questions.question: Design a valve gear mechanism for the exhaust valve of an IC engine having the following specification. i) Valve dia = 75 mm ii) Lift of valve = 25 mm iii) Weight of valve = 4 N iv) Engine speed = 275 rpm v) Minimum radius of the cam = 40 mm vi) Valve opens 33o before ODC and closes 1o after IDC and is to open & close with constant acceleration & deceleration for each half of the cycle. vii) Back pressure when the exhaust valve opens is 0.4 N/mm2 & suction pressure is 0.02 N/mm2 below atmosphere. viii) Spring stiffness is 9 N/mm & spring index is 8. Rocker arm is made up of cast steel with an I section for which ultimate tensile strength is 400 PMa. Draw two views. OR Design a centrifugal pump impeller to lift 90 liters/s of water with an effective head of 15m. 35 Motor speed is 1440 rpm and ratio of impeller diameters is 0.5 . Draw two views.
